meaning: Desired configuration only. This document performs no GitHub API call and grants no publication or account authority.

actions.runner_policy: standard ephemeral GitHub-hosted VMs; no public fork code on an owner workstation or persistent self-hosted runner
actions.future_action_policy: Exact reviewed full commit SHA, publisher and artifact review, and owner dependency-age requirements before execution

codeql.activation: pending owner activation and verification of the generated configuration and actual scans
codeql.limitations: GitHub-managed scanner versions; does not scan SQL/PLpgSQL or prove runtime authority. No claim that managed tool updates satisfy local artifact pinning and age review.

ruleset.integration_id_binding: REQUIRED live activation step: obtain the actual installed GitHub Actions App ID from successful checks and bind both contexts. The import file intentionally contains no invented ID.
ruleset.solo_owner_limit: One approval and last-push independence cannot be satisfied by a sole maintainer approving their own pull request. Owner-authored PRs also need a second genuinely independent authorized CODEOWNER because the current file names only payals. Separately authenticated bot-authored maintenance PRs can be reviewed by the owner; do not silently add a bypass.

optional_dependency_review.when_enabled: On pull_request, query the public dependency-graph comparison endpoint. Added vulnerable dependencies or unavailable/malformed API evidence fail the security job.
optional_dependency_review.limits: No third-party Python requirements or action dependencies currently exist. Custom Docker locks, operating-system packages, executable provenance, licensing and the 168-hour age decision need their separate reviewed paths.

maintenance_authority.dependabot: May propose supported manifest updates after live activation; never an approval or merge authority
maintenance_authority.advisory_model: Jev/OpenRouter review is advisory only; no check-authority, approving-review, merge, ruleset, credential, release or deployment capability
maintenance_authority.advisory_input: Explicit closed public maintenance metadata only; no repository discovery, raw source/diffs, logs, PR prose or private context
maintenance_authority.future_merge_gate: Human owner review of exact latest SHA; actual success from expected trusted check App; fresh-base tests; reviewed age/provenance/integrity/advisory evidence; no policy, evaluator, workflow, credential, isolation or migration self-approval
